summary: Dinosaur-and-sci-fi shooter series spanning Acclaim's Nintendo 64-era games, later ports/remasters, the 2008 reboot, and the upcoming Turok: Origins.

entries.title: Turok: Dinosaur Hunter

primary.why: The Nightdive remaster on PC is the most flexible high-fidelity route, while original N64/Windows releases remain historical.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows remaster on Steam/GOG; use original N64/PC only for first-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use original N64/PC only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil

primary.why: The Nightdive Windows remaster is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows remaster; use original N64/PC releases only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use original N64/PC only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion

primary.why: The 2023 Nightdive remaster is the highest-fidelity and most complete modern route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows remaster; use N64/Game Boy Color releases only for platform-history comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Keep the Game Boy Color adaptation distinct from the main N64/remastered game.

emulation.notes: Original hardware preferred for multiplayer/peripheral behavior.

primary.why: Rage Wars is a multiplayer-focused Nintendo 64 entry, with a separate Game Boy Color adaptation.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Nintendo 64 hardware or high-accuracy N64 emulation; use the GBC version only for handheld-version study.

emulation.emulator: None for Windows; Dolphin/PCSX2/xemu as fallback
emulation.notes: Use console emulation only if Windows release is unavailable.

primary.why: Evolution shipped on GameCube, PS2, Xbox, GBA, and later Windows in Europe; Windows is the highest-fidelity route where obtainable.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows release if legally preserved; otherwise Xbox/GameCube/PS2 emulation are fallback routes.

entries.title: Turok

primary.why: The 2008 reboot shipped on PS3, Xbox 360, and Windows; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate with Turok: Dinosaur Hunter; this is the 2008 reboot.

primary.platform: Unreleased - Windows / PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X/S / Nintendo Switch 2 announced
primary.why: Turok: Origins is announced for Fall 2026, but final performance, editions, and platform behavior are not yet verifiable as of 2026-06-15.
primary.how_to_play: Do not choose a definitive play route until release builds and edition details are verified.
